# What’s new in   the _all-new_ Things?
## ![Headings](https://culturedcode.com/things/2024-01-20/images/fancysection-icon-headings-io70.png)  Headings
Large projects are easier to complete when you can break them up into smaller parts – just add a few Headings!

### Divide and Conquer
Instantly you’ve got a nice, clean structure for your list, and the plan becomes perfectly clear.

## ![Checklists](https://culturedcode.com/things/2024-01-20/images/fancysection-icon-checklists-io70.png)  Checklists
For those cases we now have checklists, which help you break down the finer details of a to-do and outline precisely what’s required to get it done.

## ![Small Things](https://culturedcode.com/things/2024-01-20/images/fancysection-icon-littlethings-io70.png)  All the Small Things…
Now also shows checklists and headings.
